column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-8 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. This file replaces the retired committed enumeration,
# which was a generated projection of the gate rather than an opinion the gate is checked
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the validation-locus entries and mutant names the run read
#   checks    the check ids tools/scoped_identity_gate.py implements
# The 31 items are partitioned so each is claimed exactly once. A rejection surface takes
# both halves of its evidence where both exist — the pinned negative row that must fail and
# the generated class that must keep firing at its coverage floor — because a foreclosure a
# single hand-picked row decides is a foreclosure one edit can hollow out.
# The rank-2 index makes cross-request flow a compile-time mismatch. The direct flow table
# covers audience and integrity, while the diagnostic table pins subject mismatch, cycle,
# missing-member, and missing-path errors with their exact paths.
